objective: Determine whether existing EOS primitives can represent dynamic many-to-many value reality without creating a second fabric.

recon_matrix.evidence: Actor model supports any providerType: human, ai-agent, machine, external-service. No hierarchy constraints.
Capabilities are first-class participants that can be bound to any composition via WorkBinding.
Resource participant type added to WorkBindingSchema (atomic-composition.contracts.ts:83). Can be added as participant to any hyper-relationship.
Work can be a participant in hyper-relationship with participantType: 'work'.
Product added as participantType: 'product' in WorkBinding. LawyersHub product is first participant in composition.service.ts.
All participants share same compositionId. WorkBindingSchema requires compositionId for all bindings. Supports unlimited participant types.
Authority field exists on WorkBinding. RLS isolation preserved via workspaceId.
composition.repository.ts implements full audit logging for add/remove/update operations. All changes persisted with actor and timestamp.
Relationships can gain/lose participants without changing compositionId. compositionId is immutable - relationship identity preserved.
Specialization detected as pattern, not stored as first-class node. findPattern() scans graph for repeated relationships. No new entity required.
Organization derived from stable value relationships, not root entity. KnowledgeGraph stores organizations as nodes derived from repeated patterns.

gap_question_1.question: Can all participant types (Actor, Capability, Resource, Work, Product) be in the same relationship?
gap_question_1.evidence: composition.service.ts adds product, work, actors, and capabilities to the same compositionId. WorkBindingSchema supports all participant types.

gap_question_2.question: Can relationships change without new identity?
gap_question_2.evidence: addParticipant/removeParticipant preserve compositionId. compositionId immutable in updateWorkBinding. All history preserved in audit logs.

gap_question_3.question: Can all changes be authorized, persisted, evidenced via same fabric?
gap_question_3.evidence: Full audit log chain implemented. All WorkBindings have workspaceId for RLS. Authority field enforces permissions. Same fabric used for all operations.

gap_question_1.summary: All BETTER EOS requirements can be implemented with existing primitives as Layer 2 extensions. NO second fabric required. Only specialization and organization are non-canonical but fully representable via pattern detection. All three GAP QUESTIONS passed.
